description: This file defines API routes for managing notes in a web application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, relying on the NotesFlow for business logic.

classes.name: NotesFlow
classes.description: Handles the core business logic related to notes, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes via database operations.

classes.name: NoteRead
classes.description: Data model representing a read-only view of a note.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Data model used for creating a new note.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Data model used for updating an existing note.

classes.name: DeleteResult
classes.description: Data model indicating the result of a delete operation.

methods.name: NotesFlow _get_flow(settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings))
methods.description: Dependency-injected method to instantiate and ensure the readiness of the NotesFlow.

methods.name: list[NoteRead] list_notes(flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all notes, ordered by most recent updates.

methods.name: NoteRead create_note(payload: NoteCreate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new note with a title and content.

methods.name: NoteRead get_note(note_id: int, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteRead update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: API endpoint to update the content of an existing note.

methods.name: DeleteResult delete_note(note_id: int, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a note by its ID.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(payload: NoteCreate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow)) -> NoteRead:$/

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_note(note_id: int, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow)) -> DeleteResult:$/

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^def get_note(note_id: int, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow)) -> NoteRead:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow)) -> Note/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
